length: WGS84 ellipsoidal vertex-to-vertex geodesic km; preserve P8 sovereign-country union including Baykonur and basin allocation
identity: inherit P8 provisional geometry subset; no official identity certification inferred
topology: unique source HYRIV_ID->NEXT_DOWN directed graph; use original global upstream closure; clipped fragments never treated as independent source reaches
mainstem: unique same-ORD_CLAS upstream continuation; ambiguous continuations return N/A; separate longest-headwater-path field
offsets: orient source reach by NEXT_DOWN endpoint; project station onto its source line; measure upstream partial line by WGS84 geodesic, not fractional source length
completeness: complete only within thresholded HydroRIVERS global product; physical headwater/channel completeness not certified

pilot_selection.basin_rule: max count P8 primary provisional gauges, then max topology-qualified candidates, then basin_id; no Q scores
pilot_selection.priority: ORD_CLAS asc; lower-bound upstream area desc; stable candidate ID
pilot_selection.admission: ENGINEERING_GEOMETRY_ONLY; missing point catchment and homogeneous forcing block scientific VHS admission

missing_Q: No teacher Q; public current snapshot fields are not continuous historical training labels
stop: P9A only; no training, prediction, websites, P9B or P10
revision_reason: Make station-offset and pilot-spacing projection explicitly identical to P8; source graph and original P8 snap eligibility unchanged; no model scores involved
